design: same nine-year initial training length and three-year evaluation; monthly expanding refits; all non-date numerical settings inherited unchanged
primary_comparison: correlation-augmented ridge versus volatility-only ridge within each episode; persistence retained as a separate benchmark
comparison_rule: report both episodes separately; call cross-episode candidate only if the originally frozen candidate screen passes in both
sample_history_overlap: 2009 was a warm-up input in the prior replay; early 2010 label padding overlaps its training era; not an entirely unseen dataset
source_policy: reuse exact cached raw ZIP bytes and original acquisition receipts; record protocol freeze separately from original download time
